metadata.title: कोसा: आदिवासी और सत्ता के बीच टकराव की सच्ची कहानी | Interview with Kosa director Mohit Priyadarshi
metadata.description:
Director Mohit Priyadarshi  has made his first film, Kosa, on a sensitive but extremely important topic from tribal India. The film is based on a true story about an adivasi boy, who goes missing in Chhattisgarh, and is later found to have been arrested on suspicions of being a naxalite. In this interview, Director Mohit Priyadarshi talks to Shyam Sunder about his reasons for choosing to tell this story, how he went about researching and writing it, and the kind of films he wants to make in the future.
